limitations: This control shares the Playwright test runner, idle worker-browser dependency and launch/context settings with the performance fixture. Application markup, CSS, JavaScript and background pollers still differ together; do not infer a single cause or repeat reliability from one cohort.
The owned private launcher is consumed in-page; applicationAssetsLoaded refers to public UI JavaScript/CSS/icon resources.

The control changes multiple application costs together: real application JavaScript, CSS, icons and background pollers are absent; cards are256empty placeholders. It cannot isolate one rendering function or certify application behavior.

The actual seeded controller API, full response parsing, script-directed warmup and900-slot request/navigation/editor cadence remain; application budgets are not applied to or reduced by control measurements.
Cleanup flags record the browser context, browser root, controller root and owned synthetic fixture; they do not establish installed desktop or vendor lifecycle qualification.
Use only complete, source/runtime/binary/payload-bound observations for comparison. A complete control means valid observation, not an application performance pass.
Mac launch diagnostics, private-output architecture selection and public signing identities remain separate holds. Public BSD source mapping is already approved and complete.

The runner transforms the function serialized into the document. Exact document reconstruction uses immutable source plus the locked Playwright 1.64.1 transformer with verified public NPM package integrity and transformer file hash. Plain Node function serialization produces a different diagnostic document hash and is rejected.
